name: terminal_verify
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,json,hashlib,base64,collections
p=pathlib.Path.cwd(); h=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();m=json.loads((p/'manifest.json').read_text())
for n,z in m['files'].items():
 b=(p/n).read_bytes();assert h(b)==z['sha256'] and len(b)==z['bytes'],n
actual={str(f.relative_to(p)) for f in p.rglob('*') if f.is_file()};assert not actual-set(m['files'])-set(m['explicit_self_exclusions'])
expected='16cf264c650ea0dcae4b8cc429422a2f12cdc40bd042d7e703621380703807e0';assert h((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes())==expected;assert expected in (p/'reservation.sha256').read_text()
ids={str(x) for x in json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids']};raw=json.loads((p/'raw-provenance.json').read_text())['records'];res=json.loads((p/'keyedresults.json').read_text());assert len(ids)==len(raw)==len(res)==20 and ids==set(raw)==set(res)
for k,z in raw.items():
 b=(p/'raw'/f'{k}.jsonl').read_bytes();assert b==base64.b64decode(z['raw_base64']) and b.endswith(b'\n') and h(b)==z['raw_sha256'];assert json.loads(b)==z['object'];assert h(z['object']['statement'].encode())==z['statement_sha256'];assert h(json.dumps(z['object'],ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode())==z['object_canonical_json_sha256'];assert res[k]['credit']==0
b=json.loads((p/'search-budget.json').read_text());assert b['used_batches']==3 and b['used_queries']==9 and len(b['batches'])==3 and all(x['state']=='actual_complete' for x in b['batches']);assert sum(len(x['queries']) for x in b['batches'])==9
for i,x in enumerate(b['batches'],1):assert json.loads((p/f'search-plan-batch{i}.json').read_text())['queries']==x['queries']
a=json.loads((p/'source-access-inventory.json').read_text());assert max(a['actual_direct_GET_charges_by_id'].values())<=12
for f in p.glob('*.receipt.json'):
 o=json.loads(f.read_text());assert o['exit']==0 and o['killed'] is None,f.name
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files_verified':len(m['files']),'exact_keyed_records':20,'raw_newline_object_statement_hashes':'all verified','reservation_unchanged':expected,'search_native_calls':3,'search_queries':9,'maximum_route_GET_charge':max(a['actual_direct_GET_charges_by_id'].values()),'all_completed_runner_exits':0,'credit':0,'count':'52/60 unchanged','jobs':'all launched work foreground/joined/reaped','terminal_self_exclusions':m['explicit_self_exclusions']},indent=2))
